xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: 1 Results reviewed by AC & BOD on 13.02.23. SA conducted ltd. review of UFR. 2 UFR prepared in acc. with Ind-AS, u/s 133 of Co. Act read with Cos. (IAS) Rules, 2015. 3 Rly. Bd. inc. catering tariff for post & pre-paid trains. Effect of inc. of LF from 18.11.19 to 22.03.20 (for post paid trains) & 27.11.21 to 31.12.23 (for post & pre-paid trains) on a/c of inc. in tariff, not recognized. Co. completed sales assessment & raised demand notices for inc. LF, but some of licensees challenged in HC, Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata & Guwahati. Matter is sub-judice, impact of inc. in LF is not recognized in fin. Sts. for Q3 & for PYs upto 31.03.23. 4 Co. recognized Rly Share of Rs. 254.70 L, 15% of PFT of Deptlly run RNP & Rs 197.69 L being 40% of profits of plants run on PPP model during Q3 after charging Rly Share of Rs. 1451.24 L towards differential Rly Share @25% on profits from PPP plants for PY. Further, Rs. 546.60 L provided towards Rly Share during FY23, 15% for Departmental & PPP Plants. During FY 22, Rs. 2713.32 L was paid & charged to revenue for 15% Rly share in profits of RN plants (owned & PPP plants) up to FY21 as Rlys have not agreed with contention of Co. No provision made for FY 22 in RN segment after considering pyt. of Rs. 2713.32 L as expense. Remaining information in point no 4 is as mentioned in para8(a)(ii). 5 For 4 PPP RNP, DCOs to be reimbursed GST (net of ITC) availed by them. In absence of info. of ITC, the ITC receivable of Rs.195.95 L accounted for Q3 only for 1 plant & in PY 22-23, the impact of Rs.442.46 L (FY 2021-22 Rs. 309.28 L) was accounted for 2 plants only. DCOs represented against claim of Co. for ITC. Matter is being examined. 6 NAA issued notice dated 25.02.22 for profiteering amt. of Rs.5041.44 L u/s 171 of CGST Act for not passing the benefit of tax reduction to consumers. CCI is empowered to adjudicate matter. Proceedings stands concluded & now, if any, will be commenced afresh by CCI & no communication has been received from CCI in this matter. 7 Arbitration pronounced in Apr’22 of Rs. 7400 L & simple int. at 6% pa from July’18 onwards, in favour of certain licensees. Matter referred to Rlys as the main liability would be of Rlys & Co. has right to recovery from Rlys. As per Order dated 09.10.23, of HC, Co. has been advised to deposit BG of Rs.10521 L(Rs.7400 L & simple int. at 6% pa upto 19.08.23 i.e. till the date of filing petition). In compliance of Delhi HC, BG of Rs. 7400 L deposited with court & the award by arbitrator stayed & next hearing is on 14.02.24. 8 (a) (i) Co. received revised fixed, variable & Custody charges for 2 Tejas trains w.e.f. 13.08.21. Prov. for amt. of PY (13.08.21 to 31.03.2023) made for Rs.5190.40 L & shown as an exceptional items in FR for qtr ended 30.06.23 even though Co. made representation to Rlys for waiver. Response is awaited. (ii) MoR advised that the profits of departmentally run RNP shall be shared between IR & Co. in the ratio of 15: 85 & in case of plants operated under PPP model/run by DCO, profits between IR and Co. shall be shared in the ratio of 40: 60. Provision for nine months ended 31.12.23 in the qtr. ended 31.12.23 as per the instructions of MoR. However, provision for the differential amt. of profit sharing @25% (40%-15%) up to 31.03.23 of Rs.1451.24 L & exceptional item in FR for qtr. ended 31.12.23, even though representation made to Rly Bd. for sharing of profit in 15:85 for all RNP till FY 2022-23. Response is awaited. (b) For 22-23, net Y of Excep. items of Rs.2720 Lakhs incl. Rs.1198.59 L excess provisions written back for PY for PRP, Rs.1085.74L excess provisions written back for PY for Mnd. charges for IT & Rs. 435.67 L ex. Prov. written back for PY for various other exp. 9 Arbitral award, in C&K vs IRCTC sent to ICA, for Claim of Rs.2270 L along with interest. Co. prevailed & reliefs claimed by C&K have not been fully accepted. No fin. imp. 10. Fig. for PYs regrouped/reclassified/restated.
